shared_elements: horizontal band of repeating geometric pattern (chevron/zigzag or scroll) dividing the field
row of repeated similar figures along the top
justification: Both surfaces organise their content into horizontal registers separated by a band of repeating geometric ornament, and both include a row of repeated profile creatures along the top, but these are generic organisational devices rather than shared motifs. A is a dense, curvilinear scene dominated by seated human figures with headdresses, a central plant/tree axis and sign-like elements filling every space, while B shows isolated animal silhouettes (quadrupeds, a bird, a snake-like form) scattered on an empty ground with no humans, no interaction and no framing scroll border.
